verdict.rationale: Fin can be called programmatically through its Fin Agent API, which is effectively headless use outside the UI. There is also a Fin CLI that AI coding agents can drive to set up and configure Fin without leaving the coding environment. However, the orchestration endpoints are Preview-only, and nothing documents CI pipeline use or non-interactive automation runs. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless automation workflows (e.g., CLI non-interactive mode or CI integration), GA status for the orchestration API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Fin can be accessed programmatically via an API.
The new orchestration endpoints — Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, and Escalate to a human — are currently available in the Preview API version only.
Point your AI coding Agent at the Fin CLI to set up Fin on your website and configure your Intercom helpdesk — all without leaving your coding environment.
The Fin API platform includes APIs for answer generation and knowledge retrieval, available as a set or independently.
